infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allows taking photos of items to create Buy and Sell listings.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allows uploading gallery images for marketplace listings.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Helps find items near you and sets pickup locations.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Allows inviting friends and saving trusted sellers to phone contacts.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Enables instant biometric login to your Buy and Sell account.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Buy and Sell to use your camera.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Buy and Sell to use your location.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Buy and Sell to access your contacts.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow Buy and Sell to use Face ID.
